jobTitle: Frontend Developer - Deepdesk Apply About the role Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, power AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands like Rabobank, Vodafone, and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider. The opportunity We are looking for an experienced Frontend Developer to join our team. At Deepdesk we are building ‘Augmented Intelligence’ for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centers. We use machine learning to provide agents with real time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in their task of efficiently assisting customers. Besides providing recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants, that can take care of repetitive (boring) tasks. What you’ll be doing We are looking for an imaginative engineer, someone with a deep understanding of React/Redux, who will collaborate with Product Designers and Software Engineers to deliver compelling user-facing products. You enjoy thinking about the best UX/UI for features like real time recommendations, autocomplete, tab completion, in general anything that improves the user experience or increases utilisation. We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used (and proven) at scale. Our technology is cutting edge, and continually evolving. You will be creating the visible face of this technology, and you will be creating new user interfaces for it. What this means in practice: ● Rapid prototyping and experimenting with UX/UI ● Architecting efficient and reusable front-end SDKs and widgets ● Designing and providing complete and accurate end-to-end metrics ● Writing (and reviewing) well-tested, clean and maintainable code ● Following software engineering best practices, while staying pragmatic (don't over-engineer) Our stack ● The frontend talks with Python/Flask backend APIs running in Google Cloud Platform ● TypeScript/React with Redux for the frontend applications and widgets (HTML/CSS) ● We love beautiful code, and we love automation, so we rely on tools like ESlint, prettier and Jest to keep our code in shape. Benefits Other things this job offers: ● Work anywhere, any time ● Small team, big clients ● Start-up culture, enterprise demands ● Full autonomy, full ownership ● High standards, lots of humor ANYWHERE365 is open for People working in Software Engineering Interested to work in Rotterdam Who specialize in Frontend Development or Backend Development or Machine Learning And have following skills HTML & CSS or TypeScript or Python or React or Google Cloud Full-time position With experience level Mid-level With a capacity of 40 hours per week Our salary budget is Get the app to see The story The vision of Anywhere365® is to reduce all unnecessary dialogues by offering a solution in which the right information reaches the right person at the right time, no matter the location or channel. There are 51 – 200 employees in the company 10M to 50M Company annual revenue Offices ”Everyone is welcome at Anywhere365” is one of our foundational company culture components and we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We respect and include people for who they are with regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other characteristics. Good to know: Anywhere365 continues ‘Remote First’ as a foundation for our future workplace. For employees from The Netherlands, we still have our HQ office available in Rotterdam to facilitate (safe) hybrid working.

jobTitle: Logo of Lleverage Lleverage • Hybrid-remote Amsterdam Consultancy 25 Jul 2025 AI Engineer Apply About the role About us Hey there! We’re Lleverage.ai, and we’re making AI automation actually achievable for businesses. We enable teams to capture, automate, and integrate AI-driven workflows and agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations. We’re a team of entrepreneurs and innovators, who believe the future of work is 80% creativity, strategy, and human interaction, because AI takes care of the rest. If that sounds something you want to help build, we’d love to have you on board! Responsibilities AI Agent Development: Build intelligent agents and enhance Lleverage Copilot to automate workflows through natural language interfaces. Model Evaluation: Implement evaluation frameworks and metrics to measure AI model performance and business alignment. Model Fine-tuning: Design fine-tuning strategies for generative AI models, optimising for specific product use cases. Full-Stack Development: Build backend APIs and frontend interfaces around AI models using Next.js/TypeScript. Knowledge Base Development: Develop and optimize our off the shelf RAG-based knowledge retrieval systems. Production Monitoring: Implement monitoring and alerting systems for AI models in production environments. Iterate Fast: Contribute to fast feedback loops — release quickly, learn, and improve. Value Delivery: Constantly assess how engineering decisions impact customer value and business outcomes. Job specific requirements AI Expertise: Deep experience with generative AI models, fine-tuning, and model deployment in production environments. AI Agents & Function Calling: Proven experience building AI agents with function calling and tool use implementations. LLM Evaluation: Proven experience implementing evaluation frameworks and metrics for large language models. RAG & Knowledge Systems: Experience with Retrieval Augmented Generation architectures and vector database implementations. Developer Skills: Good familiarity proficiency in TypeScript, Next.js or similar to build end-to-end experiences. First Principals Thinker: Approach AI challenges by understanding core mechanisms rather than just applying existing frameworks—able to innovate beyond current best practices. Startup Mentality: Comfortable with ambiguity and excited to work in a fast-moving, AI-focused environment. AI Innovation: Passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible with generative AI in business automation. Nice to haves Strong proficiency in TypeScript, Next.js. Previous experience at early-stage startups or as a founding engineer Background in SaaS or low-code platforms Contributions to open source projects A carry-on ice cream bar (it's becoming our thing) We offer You are ready for the ride of a lifetime with experienced entrepreneurs and innovators who aim for hyper growth on a global scale. We look for an enormous drive and hands-on mentality. Somebody who can work with us in creating the best AI automation solution out there! We offer a good salary, a highly experienced (and very entertaining...) team and considerable share packages. Lleverage is open for People working in Data & Analytics Interested to work in Amsterdam And have following skills Frontend Development or Backend Development or Full-Stack Development or JavaScript or TypeScript Full-time position With experience level Mid-level With a capacity of 40 hours per week Our salary budget is Get the app to see The story Lleverage is the AI automation platform that captures and solves complex business processes, so our users can spend the majority of their day on the things that matter most: strategy, creativity and human interaction.
